agent_explanation: High-speed body (vx~46.6, vy~-20 at impact) strikes thin 0.2-thick wall. Per-step motion (~0.18 in x, ~0.08 in y) plus 7 substeps still lets impulse + positional correction fail to resolve contact within the 0.15 tolerance, so penetration grows  -0.007 (step39 above) -> -0.072 (step40) -> -0.152 (step41). Thickening the wall to 1.0 removes the failure, confirming thin-wall + high-speed tunneling/penetration resolution is the cause.
